title: Big O Notation (Logarithmic Climb)
style: ascending electronic, building synth arpeggios, deep sub bass, mathematical chant male lead, female harmony build, hard drums, 116 BPM, zynthio math foundations, climbing-precise, epic
lyrics:
[Intro — ascending arpeggio, sub bass]
(spoken) Big O. Logarithmic climb.

[Verse 1]
O of one is constant, the throne untouched
O of log N climbs but doesn't rush
O of N is linear, one step per item dance
O of N log N is the sort romance

[Pre-Chorus]
O of N squared is the nested pain
O of two to the N is the exponential rain

[Chorus]
BIG O NOTATION — LOGARITHMIC CLIMB
BIG O NOTATION — ASYMPTOTIC TIME
BIG O NOTATION — THE WORST CASE BOUND
BIG O NOTATION — THE ALGORITHM CROWNED

[Verse 2]
Binary search slices the sorted list in two
Log N steps and the answer comes through
Quicksort N log N average expected
Bubble sort N squared, the slow rejected

[Bridge — spoken]
Hash table O of one amortized.
Graph traversal V plus E sized.
Dijkstra and A-star, the shortest path race.
Big O measures the search-space space.

[Final Chorus]
BIG O NOTATION — THE COMPLEXITY SCALE
BIG O NOTATION — EVERY ALGORITHM TALE
BIG O NOTATION — ZYNTHIO MATH MEASURES
BIG O NOTATION — THE EFFICIENCY TREASURES
